title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco Civic Auditorium on 1984-12-29
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell Metalxial MX 90) Tascam 112MKII -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 96KHz -> Wave Lab 6.0 w/UAD -> R8brain for 16bit 44.1KHz sample rate conversion -> Traders Little Helper flac8 -> Tagged w/Tag & Rename
source: Nakamichi CM-100s w/CP-4 shotgun caps -> Sony TC-D5M. Front Row Balcony

ai_review.summary: Clear audience recording with a slight pitch issue; Stella Blue shines as the highlight.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the audio for its clarity and well‑rounded sound, noting only a minor quarter‑tone sharpness on the song "Cassidy." The performance of "Stella Blue" is singled out as especially good, making this a worthwhile listen despite the unknown set details.

ai_rating.rationale: Two 4‑star reviews highlight solid sound quality and a standout song; limited data on the musical performance keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear and well‑rounded audio; slight pitch sharpness (~¼ tone) on "Cassidy" noted by one reviewer.
